column1: ## Repository Table R22. ClinVar training ablation estimates and intervals
## Study: hEVO, reader-facing repository table release

## Description: Estimates, confidence-interval endpoints and scored sample counts synchronized from the current S42 source table. The existing all/coding/noncoding source records are retained; manuscript overall ablation uses subset all.
## Missing values: NA means unavailable or not applicable. Source precision is retained.
## Column 1 | Corpus | Training corpus used for this configuration.
## Column 2 | Window sampling | NoSW denotes nonoverlapping windows; SW denotes sliding windows.
## Column 3 | Stage | Pretraining (Stage I) or allelic refinement (Stage II).
## Column 4 | ClinVar subset | Retained S42 source stratum: all, coding or noncoding.
## Column 5 | Metric | AUROC or average precision (source label AUPRC).
## Column 6 | Estimate | Source metric_mean value, copied without rounding.
## Column 7 | CI lower | Lower confidence-interval endpoint from S42 ci_lower.
## Column 8 | CI upper | Upper confidence-interval endpoint from S42 ci_upper.
## Column 9 | Scored N | Number of scored variants recorded in S42 num_samples.
## Column 10 | Positive N | Number of positive scored variants recorded in S42 num_positive.
## Column 11 | Negative N | Number of negative scored variants recorded in S42 num_negative.
## Column 12 | Evaluation seed | Seed recorded in S42; bootstrap resample count is specified by the original run records.
